# Handy Heavens

> Cleaner • Healthier • Happier Home

Handy Heavens offers professional cleaning services for homes and commercial spaces across Delhi NCR, including Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida and Ghaziabad.

## Website
- https://handyheavens.com/

## Cleaning services
- Sofa Cleaning — deep cleaning for different types of sofas.
- Carpet Cleaning — cleaning to help remove dirt, stains and allergens.
- Mattress Cleaning — deep and hygienic mattress cleaning.
- Upholstery & Chairs Cleaning — cleaning for home and office chairs and upholstery.
- Commercial Carpet Cleaning — carpet cleaning for offices, hotels, showrooms, clinics and other commercial spaces.
- Stain & Odour Removal — treatment for stains and unwanted odours.

## How booking works
1. Request a quote by phone or through the website form.
2. Share the required cleaning service and your location.
3. Handy Heavens contacts you on WhatsApp to discuss and confirm the booking.
